mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_id,payload,status,version,publish_attempt_base,replay_count FROM tc_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_outbox SET status='SENT',published_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),published_topic=#{topic}, published_partition=#{partition},published_offset=#{offset},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE tc_outbox SET status=#{status},first_failure_at=COALESCE(first_failure_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), last_failure_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),failure_count=failure_count+1,last_publish_error=#{code},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_id,payload,status,version,publish_attempt_base,replay_count FROM tc_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
